issues.evidence: Forced Python fallback returned fhirpath_is_valid('%unknown') = true and fhirpath_is_valid('%`unknown-var`') = true; native returned false. Undefined environment variable access is an error.
issues.root_cause: Fallback evaluator converted undefined environment variable errors to empty results before fhirpath_is_valid could classify the expression as invalid.
issues.resolution: Removed undefined-variable swallowing; public result UDFs still return empty/NULL outside strict mode.

issues.evidence: Native rejected %'vs-administrative-gender' as invalid; Python grammar accepted the shape but evaluation failed.
issues.root_cause: Native percent-variable lexer only supported bare/backtick identifiers; Python external constant evaluation assumed an identifier child and ignored STRING terminal tokens.
issues.resolution: Native percent lexing now reads quoted string variable names; Python external constants unescape STRING variable names.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §10 Types and Reflection; §11 Type Safety
issues.evidence: Forced fallback hung on contact.as(BackboneElement).name.family; native returned false/empty for contact.is/as(BackboneElement).
issues.root_cause: Patient.contact model metadata was self-referential without a BackboneElement parent and TypeInfo.is_type had no cycle guard; native type checks did not fallback object-valued FHIR child fields to BackboneElement.
issues.resolution: Added cycle guard and BackboneElement parent handling for self-aliased paths; aligned native object child type checks with existing type() behavior.
issues.verified_in: test_environment_type_parity.py; fhir4ds/fhirpath pytest 1303 passed; full conformance 2822/2822
